args.title: Showing where to look
args.description: Marking targets and moving the camera in

args.text: A plain screen recording asks the viewer to work out afterwards what was clicked. This one tells them beforehand.
The target is ringed, everything around it is dimmed, and the camera moves in on it, so a small control is legible instead of a smudge.
The camera then pulls back out, and holds its framing while the next few actions are in the same area.
None of this touches the application. The move is applied to the recording afterwards, so nothing on the page is scaled or shifted.
